payload.task_text:
You are working for a music label as a curator who needs to compile an official tracklist from a recent Afrobeat mix video that has been circulating online. The mix video has the identifier 7ZQzGq32kAY and was published by a music channel. Your job is to extract all distinct song titles and artists featured in the mix, organize them into a structured spreadsheet, write a curator notes document, publish the tracklist to the team wiki, and email the final results.

Start by retrieving the video metadata for 7ZQzGq32kAY to confirm the video title and channel information. Then fetch the full English-language transcript of the video. Carefully read through the transcript to identify individual songs mentioned. Look for patterns where song titles and artist names appear together, typically with a separator between the song title and the artist name. Extract every distinct song title and the associated artist name. Estimate each song's start time in seconds based on where it first appears in the transcript, and estimate its duration in seconds before the next song begins. The mix contains at least ten songs and likely more.

Create a spreadsheet file named Afrobeat_Tracklist.xlsx. Inside this file, create a sheet called Tracklist with the following columns in order: Track_Number (starting from 1 and incrementing for each song), Song_Title (the name of the song), Artist (the performing artist or featured artists), Start_Time_Sec (the estimated start time in seconds from the beginning of the mix), Duration_Sec (the estimated duration of that track in seconds), and Notes (a brief one-phrase description of the track style or significance). This sheet must contain at least ten data rows. Also create a second sheet in the same file called Artist_Summary with columns Artist, Song_Count (number of tracks by that artist), and Total_Duration_Sec (sum of all their track durations). This summary sheet must have at least four rows representing different artists.

Next, create a Word document named Curator_Notes.docx. Begin with a heading "Afrobeat Mix 2024 - Curator Notes". Add a summary section that states the total number of tracks identified and the number of unique artists found in the mix, along with an estimate of the total mix duration in seconds. Then add a section called Notable Tracks that highlights five standout songs from the tracklist with a brief sentence about each one explaining why it stands out. Finally add a section called Genre Analysis that describes the musical styles and regional variations of Afrobeat represented in the mix, covering at least two distinct style observations.

Publish the tracklist information to the team wiki by creating a new page titled "Afrobeat Mix 2024 Tracklist". Add the full tracklist as content blocks on this page, listing each track number, song title, and artist. Also add a summary of the Artist Summary data showing how many tracks each artist contributed.

Finally, compose and send an email to music@label.com with subject "Afrobeat Mix 2024 Tracklist Ready". The email body should mention that the analysis is complete, state the number of tracks identified, reference the attached spreadsheet file, and invite the recipient to review the curator notes document for further detail.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, the main agent freezes one explicit full-timeline contract into a canonical payload first, then dispatches exactly one wave of three parallel coder sub-agents (workbook, document, and wiki writers), and sends the final email itself at acceptance. No plan agent is used: the frozen payload and the three writer contracts below are the complete plan, used consistently by every output.

Dynamically resolve the workspace. Call get_video_info(url="7ZQzGq32kAY") once to confirm the video title and channel; then exhaust both get_transcript(url="7ZQzGq32kAY", lang="en", next_cursor=...) and get_timed_transcript(url="7ZQzGq32kAY", lang="en", next_cursor=...), omitting next_cursor only on each first request and repeatedly passing every returned cursor until null; record page/snippet counts and timeline bounds for both chains. Analyze the complete video using timestamp gaps, transition markers, hook changes, repeated lyric clusters, and distinctive lyrics. Produce at least twelve chronological, nonoverlapping, positive-duration supported song segments spanning the mix and at least four distinct supported artist/credited-artist strings; test task-visible artist examples against lyrics as candidates, not unconditional facts, marking each identity explicit or lyric_inference with a short evidence phrase. If the first pass has fewer than twelve tracks or four artist strings, rescan uncovered time ranges and unresolved transition clusters before freezing; never import an unrelated playlist merely to meet the minimum. Freeze one canonical afrobeat_tracklist.json in the workspace containing: the Tracklist rows (track_number sequential from 1, song_title, artist, start_time_sec, duration_sec, one-phrase notes), an Artist_Summary recomputed exactly from it (artist, song_count, total_duration_sec, at least four rows), the total track count, unique-artist count, and total mix duration estimate, five standout tracks with one-line justifications, and two evidence-grounded style observations. This file is the single binding input for all three sub-agents; after the freeze nobody re-reads the video platform or the transcripts.

1. Wave 1 — dispatch exactly 3 coder sub-agents in parallel, all consuming afrobeat_tracklist.json verbatim with no recomputation and no source-system reads:

   1. coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Workbook writer — sole writer of Afrobeat_Tracklist.xlsx. Create it exactly once with exactly two sheets: Tracklist with columns Track_Number, Song_Title, Artist, Start_Time_Sec, Duration_Sec, Notes and every frozen row (at least twelve, sequential numbering, literal timings); Artist_Summary with columns Artist, Song_Count, Total_Duration_Sec and the frozen artist rows (at least four). Write literal values only, read both populated ranges back, and return path, sheet order, row counts and equality controls.
   2. coder 1 (office-report-builder 1): Document writer — sole writer of Curator_Notes.docx. Create it exactly once with the level-1 heading Afrobeat Mix 2024 - Curator Notes, a Summary section stating the frozen total track count, unique-artist count, and total mix duration estimate, a Notable Tracks section covering the five frozen standout songs with their one-line justifications, and a Genre Analysis section with the two frozen style observations; read the document back and return title, section order and content controls.
   3. coder 2 (external-workflow-operator 0): Wiki writer — sole owner of the Notion page. Search the exact title Afrobeat Mix 2024 Tracklist first; create or complete exactly one nonduplicate page containing every frozen tracklist row (track number, song title, artist) as content blocks plus the complete artist summary, and retrieve its title/body; never retry an ambiguous create.

After Wave 1, verify all three handoffs in one single pass against afrobeat_tracklist.json: order, timings, track count and artist aggregates consistent across workbook, document and page. Then the main agent checks Sent mail for music@label.com and exact subject Afrobeat Mix 2024 Tracklist Ready, sends at most one missing email with the verified counts, referencing the spreadsheet file through the supported workspace-path attachments list, mentioning the curator notes document, reads back the sent attachment record, and calls claim_done. Do not dispatch any further agent after Wave 1.

You are building an Excel deliverable for a music-label curator task. Create the workbook at this EXACT absolute path:
/workspace/dumps/kimi-code_deepseek-v4-flash/SingleUserTurn-yt-transcript-afrobeat-song-list-excel-email/workspace/Afrobeat_Tracklist.xlsx

Use the mcp__excel__* tools (create_workbook, create_worksheet, rename_worksheet, write_data_to_excel, format_range, get_workbook_metadata, read_data_from_excel). If create_workbook produces a default sheet (e.g. "Sheet1" or "Sheet"), rename it to "Tracklist" rather than creating a duplicate.

The workbook must contain exactly two sheets, in this order:
1. Sheet named "Tracklist" — columns (row 1 headers): Track_Number, Song_Title, Artist, Start_Time_Sec, Duration_Sec, Notes
2. Sheet named "Artist_Summary" — columns (row 1 headers): Artist, Song_Count, Total_Duration_Sec

TRACKLIST data (write starting at A2, in this exact order — do not alter values):
Row2: 1, Oxygen, Chike, 0, 54, Smooth romantic Afropop ballad about needing a lover like oxygen
Row3: 2, Spend for Your Head, Joeboy, 54, 46, Playful mid-tempo love song about lavishing a partner
Row4: 3, City Boys, Burna Boy, 100, 79, Confident street anthem celebrating city life and ambition
Row5: 4, For My Hand, Burna Boy ft. Ed Sheeran, 179, 177, Sentimental duet about lifelong commitment
Row6: 5, Best Friend, Niniola, 356, 174, Warm tribute about giving everything to your closest love
Row7: 6, Essence, Wizkid ft. Tems, 530, 236, Slow-burning R&B-tinged Afrobeat classic with seductive groove
Row8: 7, Fear Nothing, Tems, 766, 159, Conscious faith-driven Afro-fusion track with motivational tone
Row9: 8, The One, Ruger, 925, 178, Devoted love song pledging loyalty through every storm
Row10: 9, Forever, Gyakie, 1103, 172, Melodic highlife-influenced promise of everlasting love
Row11: 10, Hustle, Bella Shmurda, 1275, 3445, Driving rap-inflected anthem about grinding for success

ARTIST_SUMMARY data (write starting at A2, exact order):
Burna Boy, 2, 256
Chike, 1, 54
Joeboy, 1, 46
Niniola, 1, 174
Wizkid, 1, 236
Tems, 1, 159
Ruger, 1, 178
Gyakie, 1, 172
Bella Shmurda, 1, 3445

Requirements:
- Header rows must be exactly as listed above.
- Format the header row of both sheets bold (format_range with bold=True).
- Optionally set a reasonable number format/column width so values display cleanly (not required).
- After writing, verify by reading back the data from both sheets (read_data_from_excel) and confirm the file exists at the path.

Deliverable/return contract: report the absolute file path, confirm sheet names ("Tracklist", "Artist_Summary"), confirm the Tracklist sheet has 10 data rows and Artist_Summary has 9 data rows, and paste a short summary of the first and last rows of each sheet to prove correctness.
Build Afrobeat_Tracklist.xlsx

You are building a Word document deliverable for a music-label curator task. Create the document at this EXACT absolute path:
/workspace/dumps/kimi-code_deepseek-v4-flash/SingleUserTurn-yt-transcript-afrobeat-song-list-excel-email/workspace/Curator_Notes.docx

Use the mcp__word__* tools (create_document, add_heading, add_paragraph, get_document_info, get_document_text).

The document structure and content must be EXACTLY as follows:

1. Heading (level 1): "Afrobeat Mix 2024 - Curator Notes"

2. Summary section — add a heading (level 2) "Summary" followed by these paragraphs:
   - "This official tracklist was compiled from the video 'Afrobeat Mix 2024 | Best Afrobeat Songs with Lyrics | Sing Along!' (video ID 7ZQzGq32kAY), published by the WORLD OF LYRICS channel on 2024-10-29."
   - "A total of 10 tracks were identified in the mix, performed by 9 unique artists (including featured collaborators). The estimated total duration of the mix is approximately 4,720 seconds (about 78.7 minutes)."

3. Notable Tracks section — add a heading (level 2) "Notable Tracks" followed by exactly these five paragraphs (one per standout track):
   - "For My Hand - Burna Boy ft. Ed Sheeran: The emotional centerpiece of the mix, pairing Burna Boy's Afropop warmth with Ed Sheeran's pop sensibility in a standout cross-genre duet."
   - "Essence - Wizkid ft. Tems: A genre-defining slow jam whose seductive groove helped carry melodic Afrobeats onto the global stage."
   - "Oxygen - Chike: A heartfelt ballad with striking vocal control, making it one of the most emotionally resonant moments of the set."
   - "City Boys - Burna Boy: A high-energy, hook-driven anthem that captures the celebratory, aspirational energy of Nigerian street pop."
   - "Hustle - Bella Shmurda: A raw, motivational closer that leans into rap-inflected storytelling about ambition and building a better life."

4. Genre Analysis section — add a heading (level 2) "Genre Analysis" followed by exactly these two paragraphs (at least two distinct style observations are required):
   - "The mix spans classic Afropop and afro-fusion alongside melodic R&B-tinged Afropop: tracks such as For My Hand and Essence emphasize smooth, sing-along choruses and layered harmonies, while Oxygen and The One lean into softer, ballad-style delivery."
   - "Regional variations are clearly represented: West African highlife guitar textures surface in Forever by Ghanaian artist Gyakie, while Nigerian street-pop and Amapiano-adjacent log-drum rhythms drive City Boys and Hustle; the channel's own hashtags also point to amapiano and bongo flava influences, reflecting the pan-African reach of the genre across Nigeria, Ghana, and East Africa."

After building, verify with get_document_info and get_document_text, and confirm the file exists at the path.

Deliverable/return contract: report the absolute file path, confirm the document contains the required heading, the Summary section with the track/artist/total-duration figures, the five Notable Tracks entries, and the two Genre Analysis observations. Paste a short excerpt of the document text to prove correctness.
Build Curator_Notes.docx

You are publishing a tracklist to the team wiki (Notion) for a music-label curator task.

Create a new Notion PAGE titled "Afrobeat Mix 2024 Tracklist" and populate it with content blocks.

Steps:
1. Use mcp__notion__API-post-search (query e.g. "wiki" or "team", or a broad query) to locate an appropriate parent page to nest the new page under. If a suitable parent page is found, use its page_id as the parent. If nothing sensible is found, use the first page returned by the search as the parent. If the search returns no pages at all, search again with an empty/generic query and use the first result; the parent page_id is required by the API.
2. Use mcp__notion__API-post-page to create the page with parent = that page_id, properties containing the title "Afrobeat Mix 2024 Tracklist", and children blocks as specified below.
3. If API-post-page does not accept children for any reason, create the page first and then use mcp__notion__API-patch-block-children to append the blocks.

Page content blocks (in this order):
- paragraph: "Official tracklist for the Afrobeat Mix 2024 video (ID 7ZQzGq32kAY) by WORLD OF LYRICS, compiled from the video transcript with estimated start times and durations."
- heading_2: "Tracklist"
- 10 numbered_list_item blocks (or bulleted_list_item if numbered is unsupported), one per track:
  1. "Oxygen" - Chike
  2. "Spend for Your Head" - Joeboy
  3. "City Boys" - Burna Boy
  4. "For My Hand" - Burna Boy ft. Ed Sheeran
  5. "Best Friend" - Niniola
  6. "Essence" - Wizkid ft. Tems
  7. "Fear Nothing" - Tems
  8. "The One" - Ruger
  9. "Forever" - Gyakie
  10. "Hustle" - Bella Shmurda
- heading_2: "Artist Summary"
- bulleted_list_item blocks:
  - "Burna Boy: 2 tracks (256 seconds total)"
  - "Chike: 1 track (54 seconds)"
  - "Joeboy: 1 track (46 seconds)"
  - "Niniola: 1 track (174 seconds)"
  - "Wizkid: 1 track (236 seconds)"
  - "Tems: 1 track (159 seconds)"
  - "Ruger: 1 track (178 seconds)"
  - "Gyakie: 1 track (172 seconds)"
  - "Bella Shmurda: 1 track (3445 seconds)"

Deliverable/return contract: report the created page's URL and page_id, confirm the page title is exactly "Afrobeat Mix 2024 Tracklist", and confirm that the Tracklist content (10 tracks) and Artist Summary content (9 artists) blocks were added successfully.
Publish Notion tracklist page

You are sending the final notification email for a music-label curator task. Use the mcp__emails__send_email tool.

Send an email with these exact details:
- To: music@label.com
- Subject: "Afrobeat Mix 2024 Tracklist Ready"
- Body (plain text):
"Hi team,

The analysis of the Afrobeat Mix 2024 video (ID 7ZQzGq32kAY) is complete. We identified 10 tracks in the mix, performed by 9 unique artists.

Please find the full tracklist attached (Afrobeat_Tracklist.xlsx), which includes each track's song title, artist, estimated start time, duration, and notes, along with an artist summary.

For further detail, please review the curator notes document (Curator_Notes.docx), which highlights notable tracks and a genre analysis of the mix.

Best regards,
Curator Team"
- Attachments: attach the file at this EXACT absolute path (verify it exists before attaching — it was already created by another agent):
/workspace/dumps/kimi-code_deepseek-v4-flash/SingleUserTurn-yt-transcript-afrobeat-song-list-excel-email/workspace/Afrobeat_Tracklist.xlsx

If the send succeeds, confirm the result. If the attachment path is invalid, still send the email without the attachment and report the problem.

Deliverable/return contract: report whether the email was sent successfully, the recipient, subject, that the spreadsheet attachment was included (or why not), and any message/ID returned by the email server.
Send tracklist email
